result.title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
result.summary: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.

AI.brief_summary: 构建首个大规模原生越南语视觉蕴涵基准 OpenViVE（62,268 个图文假设对，来自 10,378 张具文化背景的图像），用 LLM 与人工结合的流程减少仅凭文本假设的捷径，并评测带双向 co-attention 的 PhoBERT-ConvNeXt 双流模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「Contradiction 准确率由 96% 降至 66%」的捷径削减诊断与 LVR 关注的视觉证据是否真被使用、视觉旁路问题直接相关；但该任务是单步分类而非 latent 状态推理，co-attention 融合对推理期状态生成的借鉴有限，主要价值在证据依赖评测可供核查。
